selection.why_next: EVT-001/Kwinana proved single-project state-as-of semantics, EVT-003 proved cognition-vintage replay and EVT-004 proved contract/inventory margin vintages. The next useful pressure is cross-project comparison with explicit counterexamples: nameplate capacity must not be equated with saleable/effective supply, but delay must not be assumed universally either.

research_question: Across a small source-grounded set of lithium-conversion projects, which state transitions and constraints explain the gap between announced/nameplate capacity and effective saleable supply, and can the model preserve an on-time counterexample rather than learning a failure-only rule?

minimum_comparison_set.reuse_policy: Reuse already archived EVT-001 evidence and typed state trajectory where claim scope matches; do not reacquire merely for symmetry.
Reuse the SHA-pinned EVT-004 2019 10-K where the expansion-pause fragment is grounded from the same immutable bytes.

required_claims: the China lithium-hydroxide capacity expansion opened on time and under budget
subsequent higher volumes were attributed to the China hydroxide expansion

semantic_dimensions: saleable output or source-supported production-volume proxy
comparison_rule: Do not create one scalar effective-supply haircut. Preserve source-defined project states and only derive effective-supply availability for a point in time when the evidence supports the required state/qualification/output semantics.
counterexample_rule: At least one timely/on-plan case must remain in the benchmark. A delayed-project cluster cannot be generalized into a universal chemical-project delay prior.

first_new_source_action.reason: Kwinana is already archived and Livent 2019 10-K bytes are already SHA-pinned. FMC is the genuinely new source acquisition needed to establish the reverse case.
first_new_source_action.target: Acquire the SEC/authoritative-redistributed 2018 shareholder disclosure and Q1 2018 results exhibit, archive exact bytes, ground completion/on-time and subsequent-volume claims, then compare against existing Kwinana/Livent evidence without mixing source clusters.

known_public_anchor.fmc_counterexample: A March 2018 SEC-filed shareholder communication states the China lithium-hydroxide expansion opened on time and under budget; a May 2018 SEC-filed Q1 results exhibit attributes higher lithium volumes to the China hydroxide expansion and Argentina debottlenecking.
known_public_anchor.source_status: discovery anchor only until exact bytes are archived through the normal Evidence path

acceptance: Use only sealed UP-CHEMICALS leads and existing archived evidence plus newly acquired claim-scoped sources.
Preserve each project's source-defined state vocabulary before any cross-project normalization.
Retain at least one on-time counterexample and one delayed/qualified case.
Do not infer saleable battery-grade supply solely from nameplate or construction completion.
Do not count multiple vintages from one project as independent evidence for a general mechanism.
Only add a new cross-industry primitive if the comparison cannot be represented truthfully with existing state, Reality/Judgment and temporal semantics.
